about.title: Call Doug direct
paragraphs: Affordable Arbor Care is Doug Leitz's tree service in Milwaukie, licensed, bonded and insured (CCB #210432).
Call or text Doug with photos of your trees and what you need done, and he'll get you a free bid.
If you know Doug, then you know it's good wood: we also sell dry, seasoned firewood.

estimate.title: Request a bid.
estimate.text: Tell us about your trees and we'll get back to you with a free bid. Photos help: text them to (503) 260-4280.
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will reach out soon with your bid.

services.name: Tree Removal
services.blurb: Safe removal of dead, damaged or unwanted trees.
services.intro: Whether a tree is dead, damaged or just in the way, we take it down safely and clean up after.
includes: Trees close to homes and structures

services.name: Pruning & Shaping
services.blurb: Healthier, better-looking trees with proper pruning.
services.intro: Good pruning keeps trees healthy, safe and looking their best.

services.name: Stump Grinding
services.blurb: Stumps ground down so you can use your yard again.
services.intro: Stump grinding removes the eyesore and lets you replant, lay sod or build.

services.name: Firewood
services.blurb: Dry, seasoned firewood: you-load bins or delivery.
services.intro: All bins are a mix of firewood types seasoned for a year or longer, covered from the rain and ready to burn.
includes: You-load bins, just shy of 1/3 cord
Call Doug about delivery or larger quantities
